name: @red-cup-engineering/computer-audio-engineering-services-section
description: Service boundary for representing, transforming, and observing digital audio: a pure, no-I/O DSP core (oscillators, envelopes, filters, delay, Karplus-Strong, formant/bow-breath synthesis, mixing, saturation, reverb, WAV encode/decode), exact-rational arithmetic for ratio-and-duration math, read-only pitch/envelope analysis of rendered buffers, and thin disk-effect scripts over @red-cup-engineering/computer-file-engineering-services-section for callers that do want a file. Domain specializations (music composition, game audio) depend on this rather than owning their own copies.

scripts.check: for f in $(find src scripts apps -name '*.mjs'); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done; echo 'all .mjs files parse cleanly'
